A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoSPaL research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison. Appendices A–F match after accounting for pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original CoSPaL experiments on VidSTG and HCSTVG-v1/v2, including benchmark results, component ablations, and quantitative and qualitative appendix analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark experiments, ablations, and appendix analyses. Tables 2–5 report the work's own results.

M1.justification: The W-GDINO adaptation and CoSPaL's TPG, CRG, and SPS components are unchanged, including their architectures, losses, query processing, curriculum, and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate VidSTG declarative and interrogative queries, HCSTVG-v1, and HCSTVG-v2. The additional movie-scene example in Appendix F.3 is also retained unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same W-GDINO, AWGU, Vis-CTX, WINNER, and fully supervised comparators. Detector and text-encoder comparisons are unchanged. The newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and the appendices retain the same dataset splits, preprocessing, frame sampling, training schedule, evaluation metrics, and experimental protocols, including the noun-versus-whole-caption comparison.

E4.justification: The component and curriculum ablations, backbone and encoder studies, decoder-layer analysis, upper-bound analysis, and qualitative success/failure cases are unchanged. The actor-localization analysis remains in Appendix D and Table 11a despite removal of its duplicate main-text summary.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No statistical reporting practice is added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–13 and the qualitative findings retain the same results. The removed main-text actor-localization paragraph repeats Appendix D and Table 11a, which still reports accuracies of 18.7, 35.5, and 38.7 for W-GDINO, TPG, and CoSPaL.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, attention construction, loss equations (1)–(5), and metric definitions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, proofs, or derivations are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same foundation-model novelty claim, three-component contribution, and effectiveness claims, including the stated 3.9% VidSTG and 7.9% HCSTVG-v1 improvements.

C2.justification: Interpretations of component benefits and limitations involving detection, tracking, ambiguous queries, and GPT phrase extraction remain unchanged. The applicability and societal-impact discussion in the appendices is also retained.

D1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E retain the same implementation settings, optimizer details, GPT prompts, hardware, and training times. The project-page and Hugging Face access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Madan et al. (2024) in the introduction and eight references in a short related-work passage distinguishing unimodal dense-task research from weakly supervised STVG. This modestly extends positioning without revising the existing grounding literature discussion.

P1.justification: v3 corrects several citation constructions, adds a brief related-work passage and Section 7 acknowledgments, and removes a redundant actor-localization summary. The main narrative and section organization otherwise remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 5 moves upward beside the computational-efficiency discussion, with corresponding changes to text wrapping and table placement on page 10. Figure images, captions, and table structures are retained; appendix layouts match apart from page numbers.

improvement.justification: v3 adds limited citation coverage, acknowledgments, and editorial polish, including placing Figure 5 beside its discussion. The method, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged. The omitted accuracy summary survives in Appendix D/Table 11a, so no evidence is lost. These localized edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
